findings.spread_note: Spread is NON-MONOTONIC. Peak at horizon 30 (0.0707), then decays to 0.0384 at 252. Spread collapses at long horizons — FAILING the growing-uncertainty requirement.
findings.ci_coverage_summary: SEVERE COLLAPSE beyond horizon 30. Coverage drops from 99.6% at d30 to 8.8% at d180 and 11.6% at d252. The model is vastly under-dispersed at long horizons.
findings.stationarity_issue: Late-horizon std (0.0022) is only 18% of early std (0.0118), confirming spread collapse / mean-reversion to a fixed attractor.
findings.cointegration_issue: Gen cointegration pass rate 56.4% vs GT 98.8% — long-horizon paths lose memory-of-level structure.
findings.kurtosis_escalation: Kurtosis escalates sharply from 7.3 (d0-30) to 31.2 (d90-180), indicating fat-tail instability in the middle horizon window.

verdict: FAIL — spread collapses with horizon (non-monotonic, ratio 0.18 by d252). CI coverage at long horizons is near-zero (8-12%). Model does not satisfy the long-horizon generation business requirement.
